primary_source.author: Lars Hörmander
primary_source.title: The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III
primary_source.reading_scope: Analytic comparison: Section 24.4, printed 443–452 / PDF 458–467, with fresh attention to Lemmas 24.4.2 and 24.4.5–24.4.7.

source_correspondence: Hörmander III Lemma 24.4.5, printed 446–447 / PDF 461–462: characteristic quadratic completion and mixed-order matrix estimate.
The delivered SDC:S5–S8 prove the complete smooth characteristic construction. The current Hilbert positivity and calculus proofs give the full matrix operator estimates.

The new W3–W7 proofs replace the interior-source substitution by an actual tangential weak test, retain the normal parameter commutator and all complex lower matrices, and transport the original natural dual.
The rough normal-commutant identity and the complete weak analogue of the strict propagation theorem and its regularized estimate are not proved by this supplement.
